correctness.rationale: The exact source phase parametrization makes branch-index nesting algebraic; compactness yields strict envelope ordering, bounded phase lifts give the uniform 1/n asymptotic, and an intermediate-value argument gives quantitative small-growth proliferation while explicitly allowing simultaneous crossings.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source leaves the higher Hopf-envelope ordering conjectural and the unbounded small-growth proliferation as a numerical/structural suggestion. Targeted searches found no later correction or source-specific proof of the strict ordering, harmonic envelope law, or quantitative proliferation theorem. Standard delay-equation phase methods are not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result rigorously establishes two central pieces of the source's higher-Hopf geometry, supplies a sharp asymptotic scale, and isolates the genuinely remaining obstacle to the stronger exact 2k-count conjecture.
